verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. لِبَنِي قُورَحَ. عَلَى «ٱلْجَوَابِ». تَرْنِيمَةٌ ٱللهُ لَنَا مَلْجَأٌ وَقُوَّةٌ. عَوْنًا فِي ٱلضِّيْقَاتِ وُجِدَ شَدِيدًا.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ لَا نَخْشَى وَلَوْ تَزَحْزَحَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ، وَلَوِ ٱنْقَلَبَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ إِلَى قَلْبِ ٱلْبِحَارِ.
verses.kjv: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.web: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

verses.ar: تَعِجُّ وَتَجِيشُ مِيَاهُهَا. تَتَزَعْزَعُ ٱلْجِبَالُ بِطُمُوِّهَا. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: [Though] the waters thereof roar [and] be troubled, [though] the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
verses.web: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

verses.ar: نَهْرٌ سَوَاقِيهِ تُفَرِّحُ مَدِينَةَ ٱللهِ، مَقْدِسَ مَسَاكِنِ ٱلْعَلِيِّ.
verses.kjv: [There is] a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy [place] of the tabernacles of the most High.
verses.web: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

verses.ar: ٱللهُ فِي وَسَطِهَا فَلَنْ تَتَزَعْزَعَ. يُعِينُهَا ٱللهُ عِنْدَ إِقْبَالِ ٱلصُّبْحِ.
verses.kjv: God [is] in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, [and that] right early.
verses.web: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

verses.ar: عَجَّتِ ٱلْأُمَمُ. تَزَعْزَعَتِ ٱلْمَمَالِكُ. أَعْطَى صَوْتَهُ، ذَابَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ.
verses.kjv: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
verses.web: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

verses.ar: رَبُّ ٱلْجُنُودِ مَعَنَا. مَلْجَأُنَا إِلَهُ يَعْقُوبَ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; the God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah.
verses.web: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

verses.ar: هَلُمُّوا ٱنْظُرُوا أَعْمَالَ ٱللهِ، كَيْفَ جَعَلَ خِرَبًا فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
verses.web: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

verses.ar: مُسَكِّنُ ٱلْحُرُوبِ إِلَى أَقْصَى ٱلْأَرْضِ. يَكْسِرُ ٱلْقَوْسَ وَيَقْطَعُ ٱلرُّمْحَ. ٱلْمَرْكَبَاتُ يُحْرِقُهَا بِٱلنَّارِ.
verses.kjv: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
verses.web: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

verses.ar: كُفُّوا وَٱعْلَمُوا أَنِّي أَنَا ٱللهُ. أَتَعَالَى بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ، أَتَعَالَى فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Be still, and know that I [am] God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
verses.web: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

verses.ar: رَبُّ ٱلْجُنُودِ مَعَنَا. مَلْجَأُنَا إِلَهُ يَعْقُوبَ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; the God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah.
verses.web: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
